A '''cafeteria''' was located in the [[Imperial Inspectorate HQ|Naval Intelligence Headquarters]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. During the early [[Imperial Era]], [[clone trooper|clone stormtrooper]]s would converse and eat [[Foodstuff|food]] in the room.<ref name="Solitary" />

==Description==
Located in the [[Imperial Inspectorate HQ|Naval Intelligence Headquarters]] in [[Imperial City]] on the [[Ecumenopolis|city planet]] of [[Coruscant]], the cafeteria was a large room where [[Foodstuff|food]] was served to [[clone trooper|clone stormtrooper]]s. The room had several tables with benches and an area on the wall where food was served on trays. Announcements could be made via a PA system.<ref name="Solitary" />

==History==
[[File:CrosshairAtImperialInspectorateCafeteria.png|thumb|left|300px|Crosshair sat at a table with two clone stormtroopers before they left him by himself.]]
After the [[Clone Wars]] ended<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the [[Proclamation of the New Order|beginning]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] to [[19 BBY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Republic]] was [[Proclamation of the New Order|replaced]] by the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Episode III" /> The Naval Intelligence Headquarters was then constructed over the monads of the Republic Center for Military Operations.<ref name="Aphra 15">[[Doctor Aphra (2016) 15|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 15]]</ref> Later that same [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date">{{Disney|subdomain=press|domain=co.uk|url=press-kit/star-wars:-the-bad-batch-season-2|text=Star Wars: The Bad Batch, Season 2 Press Kit}} places [[The Bad Batch Season 2|''The Bad Batch'' Season 2]] [[Standard month|months]] after [[The Bad Batch Season 1|''The Bad Batch'' Season 1]], which can be placed in and around [[19 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. Therefore Season 2 takes place in approximately the same [[Standard year|year]].</ref> [[clone commando]] [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair" carried his tray of food to a table where two [[Cloning|clone]] [[stormtrooper]]s were eating a<ref name="Solitary" /> spartan meal<ref name="Solitary Audio">{{TBB|The Solitary Clone}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> and discussing the [[Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill]]. As Crosshair sat down to eat, the two troopers, still seeing Crosshair as an outsider due to his genetic mutations, got up and left the table, leaving Crosshair by himself. Immediately after, a voice on the PA ordered him to report to [[Vice Admiral Rampart's office|Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart's office]].<ref name="Solitary" />

Crosshair later ate in the cafeteria after his return from his [[Mission to Desix]]. While he was eating, the voice on the PA once again ordered Crosshair to report to [[Edmon Rampart|Rampart]]'s office while in the middle of his meal.<ref name="Solitary" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Inspectorate cafeteria first appeared in "[[The Solitary Clone]]," the third episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' animated series,<ref name="Solitary" /> which was released on [[January 11]], [[2023]].<ref name="Airdate">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}}</ref>
